description: An analytically minded student interested in Data Science who excels in math but feels hesitant about the low-level implementation details of C++.

nodes.title: C++ Memory Foundations
nodes.personalizationRationale: Since the student has some_prior_exposure, this targeted scaffolding node bridges their existing programming knowledge with specific C++ memory management and pointer logic.
nodes.description: Refresher on C++ pointers, references, and manual memory management logic to bridge previous programming experience with C++ specific semantics.
Core study of C++ classes, inheritance, and the use of templates for generic data structure design.
nodes.personalizationRationale: With some_prior_exposure established, this core node ensures the student masters C++ templates and inheritance for robust object-oriented design.
nodes.title: Object-Oriented Design & Templates
Linked List Implementations
nodes.personalizationRationale: Building on their some_prior_exposure, the student will implement foundational linked list structures, a core requirement of the syllabus.
nodes.description: Implementation of singly and doubly linked lists, focusing on pointer manipulation and node-based structures.

nodes.title: Asymptotic Analysis (Big-O)
nodes.description: Introduction to formal performance analysis using Big-O, Big-Omega, and Big-Theta notation.
nodes.personalizationRationale: The student will apply their some_prior_exposure to analyze code efficiency using Big-O notation, a core skill for all future units.

nodes.title: Quiz 1: Recursion & Lists
nodes.description: Assessment covering recursion depth, base cases, and linked list operations.
nodes.personalizationRationale: This core assessment verifies that the student with some_prior_exposure can handle recursive call stacks and logic patterns effectively.

nodes.title: Stacks and Queues
nodes.description: Implementing Stack and Queue Abstract Data Types using array-based and list-based underlying structures.
nodes.personalizationRationale: Developing core competency in ADTs, the student with some_prior_exposure will implement stacks and queues using sequential arrays.

nodes.title: Vectors and Iterators
nodes.personalizationRationale: Leveraging their some_prior_exposure, the student will explore core C++ sequence containers like vectors and the iterator pattern.
nodes.description: Exploration of the Vector class and the use of Iterators for traversing sequence-based structures.
Implementation and analysis of the Bubble Sort algorithm within the context of sequence ADTs.
nodes.personalizationRationale: The student with some_prior_exposure will master core sequence manipulation through the implementation of bubble sort.
nodes.title: Sequences & Bubble Sort
Midterm Review Checkpoint
nodes.personalizationRationale: This mandatory checkpoint allows the student with some_prior_exposure to synthesize all linear structures and Big-O concepts before the midterm.
nodes.description: Comprehensive review and self-assessment of all linear structures and Big-O concepts covered in the first half of the course.
General tree definitions, parent-child relationships, and depth-first vs. breadth-first traversal algorithms.
nodes.personalizationRationale: Transitioning to non-linear structures, the student with some_prior_exposure will master core general tree definitions and traversals.
nodes.title: General Trees and Traversals
Binary Tree Properties
nodes.personalizationRationale: The student with some_prior_exposure will focus on core binary tree implementations, essential for subsequent search tree topics.
nodes.description: Core properties of binary trees, including height, depth, and efficient node representation in C++.

nodes.title: Priority Queues and Heaps
nodes.description: Implementation of Heaps as a backing structure for Priority Queues, focusing on the bubble-up and bubble-down operations.
nodes.personalizationRationale: The student with some_prior_exposure will learn core heap-based implementations of priority queues to maintain efficient ordering.

nodes.title: Hash Functions and Tables
nodes.description: Design of efficient hash functions and strategies for collision resolution (chaining vs. open addressing).
nodes.personalizationRationale: Drawing on their some_prior_exposure to arrays, the student will master core hash table mechanics and key mapping techniques.

nodes.description: Ordered Map ADTs and the implementation of Skip Lists for logarithmic search complexity.
nodes.personalizationRationale: This core node introduces the student with some_prior_exposure to skip lists as an alternative to balanced trees for sorted map ADTs.
nodes.title: Maps and Skip Lists

nodes.description: Binary Search Tree mechanics and the implementation of AVL tree rotations to maintain balance.
nodes.personalizationRationale: The student with some_prior_exposure will dive into core BST and AVL tree logic, focusing on maintaining balance during insertions.
nodes.title: BST and AVL Trees平衡
Multi-Way and Red-Black Trees
nodes.personalizationRationale: To complete the search tree core requirements, the student with some_prior_exposure will study Red-Black tree properties and rotations.
nodes.description: Introduction to (2,4) trees and their relationship to Red-Black tree properties and performance.
Core sorting algorithms including the recursive Merge Sort and the iterative Selection Sort.
nodes.personalizationRationale: The student with some_prior_exposure will implement core sorting algorithms, including the selection sort and merge sort methods.
nodes.title: Merge and Selection Sort
Capstone Integrative Review
nodes.personalizationRationale: Reviewing the cumulative syllabus, the student with some_prior_exposure will synthesize their understanding of structures and algorithmic efficiency.
nodes.description: Integration of various data structures into complete problem-solving systems; cumulative overview of course themes.

nodes.personalizationRationale: This final assessment ensures the student with some_prior_exposure is prepared for the cumulative exam covering the entire course curriculum.
nodes.description: Final cumulative review and preparation for the comprehensive final exam.
nodes.title: Final Exam Preparation
